answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 44830 Country: India Title: Azkaar Question: Can I get a prepared time table on azkar that I can do starting from the morning (Fajr) till I go to bed (Isha)? Answer ID: 44830 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 611/498/B=1434) We are sorry we do not have a timetable. As per the elders the time of azkar is the morning and evening. The morning means when you get up before Fajr then at that time or after Fajr get yourself busy in zikr, while the evening means after Asr. You should finish your zikr from Asr till going to bed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
